The distinct glow of this sneaky river snail has diminished after it's been frozen, but eating it like this will provide a temporary increase to your heat resistance.|Inventory|TotK}} ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== Frozen River Snails are a type of [[Frozen Food]]. [[Link]] can make Frozen River Snails by exposing [[Sneaky River Snail]]s to [[Freezing Climate]]s or [[Cold Water]].{{Cite Guide|BotW Piggyback|page= 295}} Sneaky River Snails are noted to no longer glow after being frozen. Eating one restores one of [[Link]]'s [[Heart]]s and grants temporary [[Heat Resistance]]. ==={{TotK|-}}=== Frozen River Snails reappear in {{TotK}} as a variety of [[Frozen Food]]. They can be made by exposing [[Sneaky River Snail]]s to a [[Freezing Climate]] or [[Cold Water]]. Due to being frozen, Sneaky River Snails lose their ability to glow. If [[Link]] eats a Frozen River Snail, he will heal one [[Heart]] and receive one level of temporary [[Heat Resistance]]. ==Nomenclature== {{Nomenclature}} ==See Also== {{See Also| * Food * Frozen Food * Icy Hearty Blueshell Snail * Sneaky River Escargot * Sneaky River Snail }} {{Ref}} {{Categories |Food, Frozen Food, Health Restoring Items, Seafood |items= BotW, TotK }}
